title: Azzurro Moon
meta_description: Find the perfect Seagrove Beach, FL vacation rental at Azzurro Moon, a luxury 4-bed, 8-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Seagrove Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 4 Bedrooms & 8 Full Baths • Sleeps 14 • Gulf Front with Private Beach • Private Rooftop Pool. (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 4 Stories & 4,216 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Beach Chair Setup (4 Chairs and 2 Umbrella) Provided March 1st - October 31st • Elevator • Parking for 3 Vehicles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Living Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa & Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 8) • Bedroom 1: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities & Tile/Glass Shower (Gulf Front with Shared Balcony) • Bedroom 2: Three Twin over Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 6) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower FOURTH FLOOR (Sleeps 4) • Bedroom 3: Primary Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Modern Soaking Tub Tile/Glass Shower | Private Balcony with Gulf Views • Bedroom 4: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower DESCRIPTION: Experience the epitome of 30A living at ‘Azzurro Moon’, a newly built Gulf-front Villa in Seagrove Beach, designed to blend elegance with coastal luxury. This four-bedroom, eight-bath retreat spans 4,200 square feet, providing ample space to accommodate up to 14 guests in stylish comfort. Every floor is accessible by a private elevator, ensuring ease of movement through this four-story home, which also features a rooftop terrace with private pool, and shared boardwalk for direct beach access complete with a complimentary beach setup. Upon arrival, guests are greeted by the inviting first-floor living area, showcasing panoramic views of the pristine Gulf waters framed by expansive picture windows. This level is thoughtfully equipped with a queen sleeper sofa, full bathroom, and a convenient wet bar with a mini fridge, perfect for refreshments after a day in the sun. Step directly from this level onto the sand, where the Gulf awaits. Ascend to the second floor, where sophistication meets comfort in a cozy yet spacious living room. A plush sectional and gas fireplace set a warm ambiance, ideal for unwinding with family and friends. Gather around the elegant 10-seat dining table or the five-seat breakfast bar for meals prepared in the gourmet kitchen, which boasts quartzite countertops, a Wolf 6-burner gas range with double oven, and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Just outside, the second-floor balcony beckons with a natural gas grill and alfresco dining setup, perfect for savoring a meal while soaking in the Gulf breeze. The third floor offers convenient amenities, including a second wet bar with a mini fridge, a laundry room with dual washers and dryers, and an attached full bathroom. Here, two beautifully appointed guest bedrooms open onto a shared balcony with sweeping Gulf views, inviting guests to wake to the sound of the waves each morning. The fourth floor is dedicated to ultimate relaxation, featuring two stunning primary suites that lead to a balcony and, just beyond, stairs to a private rooftop oasis. This elevated deck, crowned with a sleek stainless steel pool and surrounded by eight loungers, is designed for sun-soaked days and starlit nights, providing an unparalleled vantage point to enjoy the breathtaking coastal scenery. On-site parking, six adult bikes, and a six-seater golf cart make exploring nearby Seagrove Beach a breeze. Just a stroll or bike ride away, guests will find an array of beloved local spots, including Old Florida Fish House, known for its vibrant live music and delicious seafood; Beachy Bean Coffee Co., a perfect morning stop; and Buddy's Seafood Market, offering fresh seafood and grocery essentials. Whether you’re discovering the charms of 30A for the first time or returning to your favorite beach destination, ‘Azzurro Moon’ promises an exquisite escape that captures the essence of coastal luxury. LAYOUT: FIRST FLOOR: • Gulf Front Media Room with Wet Bar • Elevator • Full Bath with Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Main Living Area with Gas Fireplace • Chef's dream kitchen with 6 burner Wolf stove, wine fridge, ice maker, oversized Sub Zero fridge, convection microwave & dishwasher • Spacious Island with seating for 5 • Expansive dining table with seating for 10 • Balcony with outdoor dining for 6 & Grilling Station • Full Guest Bath THIRD FLOOR: • Game Area and Wet Bar • Laundry Room with 2 Front Load Washers & 2 Front Load Dryers • Full Bathroom • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Bunk Room with 3 Twin Over Twin Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom • Shared Balcony FOURTH FLOOR: • Primary Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Full Guest Bath • Balcony Access ROOFTOP: • Rooftop Pool • 8 Loungers CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Seagrove Proper (2 Miles) • The Big Chill (2.2 Miles) • WaterColor Publix (4 Miles) • Seaside (4 Miles) • Alys Beach (4.8 Miles) • Rosemary Beach (5 Miles)
